test_title: RRB Technician Grade 1 19 Dec 2024 Shift 2 Official Paper
subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by two arguments. Decide which of the arguments is/are strong with respect to the statement.

**Statement:**

The Government of country B has urged its citizens to invest in rain water harvesting and avail subsidies in doing so.

**Arguments:**

I. Ground water resources have been continuously depleting in country B.

II. Country B experiences heavy rainfall during the monsoon season leading to flooding in many low-lying areas.

options.text: Both I and II weaken the statement.
Both I and II strengthen the statement
II weakens while I strengthens the statement.
I weakens while II strengthens the statement.
